philippines.title: Remulla to visit France amid Zaldy Co and Loren Legarda’s stay
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla on Monday said he will visit France to coordinate with authorities after Sen. Loren Legarda and former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co stayed there amid their cases here. Legarda is facing a plunder complaint before the Ombudsman while Co is subject of two malversation cases now handled by the Sandiganbayan. “I will go to France in the coming days to talk to French authorities, because France should not be a safe haven for plunderers and ill-gotten wealth,” Remulla said in a press conference in Filipino. “Because Zaldy Co is there. philippines.title: Man accused of stealing rooster bludgeoned in Consolacion
philippines.description:
CEBU PROVINCE, Philippines – A still-unidentified man died after being struck in the face with a molded block of concrete in Villa Roca, Barangay Poblacion Occidental, Consolacion, Cebu, around 11:30 p.m. on Sunday, September 6, 2026. A resident who had caught him allegedly stealing a game fowl dealt the blow and has surrendered to the police. Police described the victim as wearing a sleeveless shirt and a denim skirt. He had a tattoo on his right thigh, sky-blue fingernail polish, and a surgical scar on his abdomen....
